content: Dcm behavior on sub-function stopSending without further parameters On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier (0x2A) with transmissionMode = stopSending and no periodicDataIdentifier in the request, the Dcm shall stop all scheduled periodicDataIdentifier transmissions.
